;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility via its [[Amaq News Agency]] for a bombing that killed and wounded several [[Egyptian Army]] personnel near the city of [[Bir al-Abd]] in [[North Sinai Governorate]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-egypt-security/islamic-state-claims-responsibility-for-egypts-sinai-attack-idUKKBN22D64L (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Lebanon]]'s banking association rejects a plan proposed by [[Government of Lebanon|the government]] to secure emergency funding from the [[International Monetary Fund]], saying they were not consulted and the plan will "further destroy confidence" in the country's financial system. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-crisis-plan/lebanon-banks-reject-rescue-plan-as-government-asks-imf-for-help-idUSKBN22D5NG?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*All five crew members declared missing after the crash of a [[Canada|Canadian]] [[Sikorsky CH-148 Cyclone|CH-148 Cyclone]] helicopter two days earlier are now presumed dead. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/may/02/five-crew-of-canadian-helicopter-presumed-dead-after-crash-off-greek-coast (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
*[[South Hedland stabbing attack]]
**A [[fly-in fly-out]] worker from [[Perth]] attacks seven people in [[South Hedland, Western Australia]]. None were killed, though five were hospitalised. [[Western Australia Police|Police]] shot the attacker dead. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2020/may/01/wa-police-shoot-man-dead-after-five-people-stabbed-in-pilbara-shopping-centre (''The Guardian'')]
*A [[prison riot|riot]] over [[Shortages in Venezuela|food shortages]] at the overcrowded Los Llanos prison in [[Guanare]], [[Portuguesa (state)|Portuguesa]], [[Venezuela]], leaves at least 46 people dead and dozens more injured, including the prison's director, according to the [[National Bolivarian Armed Forces of Venezuela|military]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-52517167 (BBC News)] [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1268328/at-least-17-dead-in-venezuela-prison-riot-says-military (''Inquirer'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Gun control in Canada]]
**[[Canadian Prime Minister|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] announces a ban on [[Assault weapon|assault-style weapons]], which includes buying, selling, transporting, importing or using the designated weapons. The legislation is said to be motivated by [[2020 Nova Scotia attacks|last month's killing spree]] in [[Nova Scotia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-guns/canada-bans-assault-style-weapons-in-aftermath-of-mass-shooting-idUSKBN22D62V?il=0 (Reuters)]
